notes: Demand points are the 2020 Census chōme centroids across Saitama, Chiba, Tōkyō and Kanagawa, matched to Economic Census workplace counts. Japan publishes no origin-destination commute matrix, so flows are synthesised with a doubly-constrained gravity model calibrated against the census's own municipality-level self-containment ratios, then routed with OSRM. Full method: [Methodology.md github](https://github.com/MasterPapple/subwaybuilder-greater-tokyo/blob/master/METHODOLOGY.md)
